reasoning_traces.think:
The system operates as a hierarchical Bayesian inference engine where Stage 0 ingests structured data into a canonical game state. The situational layer applies domain-specific priors derived from coaching behavior and environmental factors. These priors are then embedded into a 10,000-world Student-t copula trajectory simulator, which models player outcomes under uncertainty. The cognitive self-improvement layer refines these outcomes using multi-agent expectimax planning and authority-weighted feedback loops. Finally, a two-stage MILP optimizer translates these probabilistic outcomes into actionable DraftKings lineups. Each stage introduces a distinct failure mode: data inconsistency in ingestion, misapplied priors in situational reasoning, insufficient simulation worlds, or suboptimal MILP solutions due to constraint violations.
